children: According to CNBC, Bank of England Deputy Governor Sarah Breeden said Thursday that hedge funds’ growing role in global bond markets and their use of leverage have increased the likelihood that shocks in one market will spread to others. She said bond-market investors increasingly include price-sensitive, leveraged, international hedge funds rather than mainly insurers and pension funds.

title: Sarah Breeden: Hedge Funds Make Broader Bond Market Shocks More Likely
